narrative.overview: Buhj uses compact layouts, neutral surfaces, and quiet dividers so people can read a month of activity and trace totals to individual records. Keep the date and account scope near the figures they qualify. Give the page title, the next action, and the figures enough weight to establish the reading order.
keyCharacteristics: Matte light and dark surfaces with one lavender accent.
Compact navigation with a visible label for each destination.
Tabular amounts and labeled states that read in grayscale.
dos: Do check light and dark rendering, keyboard focus, and narrow layouts when adding a shared component or page.
Do check that users can identify selections, inflows, and outflows in grayscale.
donts: Don't assign new page-specific colors to a role already covered by the shared theme.
